conflictLedger.conflict: The controlling registry contains Rumin commander, general, and city rows, but none of the 18 constructed replacement cards present in the implementation.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Use repository definitions only to illustrate current implementation behavior. Do not change mechanics, claim registry authority, or promote the cards to canon. Mark every constructed asset as implementation-bound pending registry reconciliation.

conflictLedger.conflict: Creative OS uses Kaisar while the current implementation and requested card title use Kaiser.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Treat them as the same Rumin figure for visual continuity, retain current implementation labels, and bake no name or lettering into art.

conflictLedger.conflict: Verified C-09 says Meerus establishes imperial order; the current chapter implementation names Augustus as the first emperor.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: The chapter art depicts the institutional transition to empire and an intentionally non-identifying ruler in republican ceremony. It does not establish Augustus visually or contradict the Meerus trajectory. The content-name mismatch remains visible for a separate governed reconciliation.

conflictLedger.conflict: The available Rumin visual families are Pending Review or Not Canon with rights status Needs Truth; no Rumin asset family is recorded as an approved governing visual identity.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Do not reference those images directly in generation. Derive candidate style from verified written authorities, the user's explicit direction, and the operational Gauntlet visual contract.

variantPolicy: Each gameplay card has one canonical illustration. Standard and collector-foil variants reference the same art path; finish remains presentation-only.

assetPolicy.governingInput: Verified written Creative OS authorities plus current repository implementation facts.

assets.title: Gilded Scale Legionary
assets.visualSubject: A disciplined Rumin legionary advancing through a monumental civic gate as market officials and supply clerks record the column; restrained gilded scale edges and diamond-shaped bronze inlays connect military service to the public economy.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin Roman military and civic-finance transformation; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Republican legion discipline, triumphal gate, paved road, marble, bronze, leather, linen, red-ochre standard cloth without symbols.
mustPreserve: disciplined civic soldier rather than monster
economy and army in one lived scene

assets.title: Forum Ledger Runner
assets.visualSubject: A swift civic courier threading through a crowded colonnaded forum at first light, protecting bound ledger tablets while merchants open stalls and magistrates wait on the steps.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin civic administration and market infrastructure; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Forum colonnades, stairways, awnings, wax tablets, leather satchel, marble and morning bronze light.

assets.title: Vault Shield Bearer
assets.visualSubject: A vault guard braces a layered bronze-and-hide shield across a treasury threshold while clerks behind the guard add counterweights and secure public deposits during a breach.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin protection through institutional systems; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Basilica vault entrance, bronze lattice, dark basalt sill, hide straps, measured counterweights, warm marble.

assets.title: Coin-Scale Spear
assets.visualSubject: A recognizable long spear with a leaf-shaped bronze point and scale-like counterbalance is passed from a civic armory rack to a departing legionary, viewed on a strong diagonal in active preparation.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin military equipment shaped by weights, measures, and civic supply; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Bronze spearhead, ash shaft, coin-scale counterweight, stone armory, inventory racks, controlled daylight.
mustPreserve: active handoff rather than catalog pose

assets.title: Senate Vault Guard
assets.visualSubject: A senior Senate treasury guard holds the line between petitioning citizens and a sealed public vault while an official weighs an unusually large payment behind the guard.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin political hierarchy, public finance, and ambiguous protection; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Senate basilica, bronze vault doors, marble steps, red-black guard armor, scales and sealed deposit jars.

assets.title: Marble Market Tribune
assets.visualSubject: A forceful market tribune adjudicates a dispute from a low marble rostrum as guild weapons, cargo, citizens, and soldiers converge around the ruling.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin political and economic office expressed through a shared civic arena; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Market basilica, marble rostrum, bronze rail, linen robes over scale armor, amphorae and weapon guild display.

assets.title: Rumie Vault Shield
assets.visualSubject: A distinct round-edged vault shield of overlapping bronze scales protects a treasury convoy in a narrow forum street, carried low and forward as attackers close in.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin weapon design rooted in vault craft and civic logistics; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Overlapping bronze plates, basalt boss, leather grip, locked civic carts, colonnaded street, dust and sunset.

assets.title: Imperial Scale Pike
assets.visualSubject: A long imperial pike rises above a coordinated serpent phalanx advancing down a paved military road, its repeating scale joints visually echoing the formation.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin imperial military coordination and road infrastructure; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Ash-wood pikes, bronze leaf points, articulated scale collars, road milestones without text, legion leather and linen.

assets.title: Aurelian Clawblade
assets.visualSubject: A master armorer presents a rare bronze clawblade during a civic oath inside an austere state forge; one legionary receives it while witnesses measure the paid offering.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin rare military craft embedded in civic obligation; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Dark state forge, bronze and restrained gold, three practical hooked blades on one gauntlet, marble oath plinth, scales and sealed offerings.
mustPreserve: three controlled blades attached to one forearm

assets.title: Basilisk Standard
assets.visualSubject: A tall basilisk standard is carried through a crowded military-civic procession, its abstract serpent silhouette visible in worn red cloth while armed cohorts pass banks and public works.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin standard as civic and military signal, not a monster portrait; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Worn red textile, bronze crossbar and serpent finial, forum avenue, citizens, veterans, civic buildings.

assets.title: Jewel-Bank Contract
assets.visualSubject: At the center of a monumental bank atrium, a merchant and magistrate exchange one heavily weighted sealed contract while guarantors, clerks, guards, and waiting citizens reveal the social stakes.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin contract power, debt, generosity, obligation, and finance as institution; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Bank basilica, marble counters, bronze balance, wax seals without writing, restrained jewel inlay, ledgers and grain receipts.
mustPreserve: single contract exchange as focal action
moral ambiguity rather than villain scene

assets.title: Tax-Road Scout
assets.visualSubject: A lightly equipped Rumin surveyor races ahead of a trade caravan on a newly laid stone road, checking bridges, toll stations, and supply markers before the column arrives.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin roads, taxation, trade, and expansion as one civic system; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Stone road, arch bridge, modest toll shelter, survey cord, tablet without writing, linen travel gear, dry frontier terrain.

assets.title: Marble Phalanx
assets.visualSubject: A disciplined Rumin shield wall pivots from advance to defense at the edge of a marble quarry-city, protecting workers and supply carts behind overlapping shields.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin collective military discipline protecting civic production; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Marble quarry terraces, unfinished columns, bronze-rimmed shields, pikes, dust, pale stone and red cloth.

assets.title: Counting-House Aegis
assets.visualSubject: A fortified counting house closes its enormous bronze lattice and layered shutters while clerks, guards, and citizens organize deposits behind a protective architectural aegis.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin protection embodied by resilient civic finance architecture; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Basilica counting hall, bronze grille, marble ribs, ledger alcoves, sealed jars, measured counterweights, warm interior against storm light.

assets.title: Triumphal Ram
assets.visualSubject: A heavy civic-engineered battering ram with a restrained bronze serpent head is hauled through a breached frontier gate by a coordinated legion, monumental but physically credible.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin expansion through state engineering and disciplined force; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Timber frame, rope rigging, bronze ram head, stone gate, legion crews, road engineers, smoke and pale dust.
mustPreserve: serpent head as restrained craft motif

assets.title: Edict of the Vault
assets.visualSubject: A high magistrate seals a vault edict before gathered guild delegates as guards close the bronze doors and a fourth armed cohort waits beyond the tribunal.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin political authority converting finance law into military action; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Vault tribunal, marble benches, wax seal and blank decree surface, bronze doors, civic robes, armed cohort in sharp backlight.

assets.title: Kaiser's Gold Claw
assets.visualSubject: Kaiser raises a singular gold-and-bronze claw weapon before the fourth assault, surrounded by fed citizens, loyal veterans, indebted allies, and uneasy senators in one morally divided civic-military tableau.
assets.factionAuthority: Kaisar/Kaiser as genuinely generous and power-concentrating; implementation spelling retained without text.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Forum command stair, worn gold leaf over bronze, practical claw gauntlet, legion standards, food distribution, marble and storm-red sky.
mustPreserve: same Kaisar/Kaiser figure implied without written name
generosity and coercive loyalty visible together
mythic scale through crowd and composition

assets.title: Rumie Market Colossus
assets.visualSubject: A towering but living Rumin civic champion rises above Rumie's central market while guilds and cohorts pass up shields, pikes, standards, and a clawblade; the colossus embodies the market system mobilized for war, not a monster or automaton.
assets.factionAuthority: Rumin mythic civic-economic power and collective armament; implementation-bound constructed content.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Monumental forum, tiered market balconies, bronze and marble, guild awnings, civic champion in layered scale armor, multiple clearly separated weapons.
mustPreserve: each weapon readable and physically handed up

assets.title: Brothers of Destiny
assets.visualSubject: Before empire, Rolmus and Remex stand separated within one young frontier city: Rolmus oversees a market road and bridge taking shape while Remex directs a defensive wall and barracks; their personal rivalry is expressed through the city they are founding.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 Roman foundation trajectory and current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Rough early stone, timber scaffolds, nascent forum, road survey, defensive wall, river crossing, dawn earth tones with restrained red cloth.

assets.title: The Republic
assets.visualSubject: A packed republican forum debates beneath the senate basilica while citizens petition, bankers weigh deposits, legionaries watch, and a narrow stream of wealth quietly enters a senators-only arcade.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 Roman republic as primary skeleton with finance as transformation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Republican senate steps, public rostrum, market stalls, bank counters, marble worn by crowds, bronze scales, civic red and bone.

assets.title: The Jewel
assets.visualSubject: Young Kaiser walks among workers and debtors in a prosperous but unequal market, publicly paying an obligation and confronting Governor Severan on the steps of a protected jewel-bank enclave.
assets.factionAuthority: Kaisar's generosity and power-building contradiction under C-09; implementation spelling retained without text.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Marble market, jewel-bank grille, bread and oil distribution, wax-sealed debt tablets, officer's civic armor, crowd and elite balcony.

assets.title: The Gaulic Wars
assets.visualSubject: On a cold northern frontier, Kaiser leads Rumin legions along a newly cut road toward Vercan's united warbands, with forested hills, supply columns, and contested trade routes widening the scene beyond a duel.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 military expansion and Roman structural anchor; current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Mud and stone road works, frontier earthworks, disciplined bronze-and-red legion, varied northern Rumin tribal materials, overcast green-gray light.

assets.title: The Three Runes
assets.visualSubject: Deep below conquered land, Kaiser enters an ancient stone vault where a non-humanoid guardian stands between him and three distinct geometric relic-stones; waiting legionaries remain small at the threshold.
assets.factionAuthority: Current chapter content bounded by C-09; runes are strategic sacred relics, not generic spell loot.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Pre-Rumie cyclopean stone, bronze vault rings, three restrained luminous forms, dust, old water channels, legion lamps.

assets.title: The First Empire Bank
assets.visualSubject: Rumie's first empire bank operates as a vast civic system: a basilica bank linked to grain depots, aqueducts, paved roads, clerks, carts, and public queues while a small sabotage attempt is contained at the edge.
assets.factionAuthority: Finance as imperial infrastructure and Kaisar's genuine prosperity/power contradiction under C-09.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Bank basilica, granary arcades, aqueduct, road hub, bronze scales, ledger counters, public works crews, bone marble and verdigris roofs.
mustPreserve: roads, grain, public works, and bureaucracy

assets.title: The Crossing
assets.visualSubject: At dusk, Kaiser's legions cross a monumental stone boundary bridge and checkpoint toward Rumie while Brutus remains on the near side and Cassius's Senate force blocks the distant road; the physical threshold makes the political point of no return unmistakable.
assets.factionAuthority: Current chapter's law-versus-loyalty threshold within C-09's fall-of-Republic trajectory; no unapproved named river is invented.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Stone causeway, civic boundary pillars without text, legion column, Senate standards, river gorge, dark red dusk and steel-blue distance.

assets.title: The Last Republic
assets.visualSubject: Senate Square becomes the final civic battlefield: Kaiser's legions push through broken barricades while Brutus leads the last republican defenders beneath damaged colonnades, with citizens fleeing between institutions both sides claim to save.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 fall of the Republic, morally contradictory power, and current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Senate square, scorched marble, broken rostrum, legion formations, republican civic guards, smoke, ember red against bone stone.
mustPreserve: political collision rather than anonymous war
Kaiser and Brutus embedded in opposing systems

assets.title: Emperor of Gold
assets.visualSubject: At Kaiser's imperial peak, one panoramic civic vista holds new roads, strong banks, fed markets, disciplined legions, tax queues, and shadowed prison arches beneath the same golden administration.
assets.factionAuthority: Kaisar's prosperity and concentrated coercion must remain simultaneously legible under C-09.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Imperial forum terrace, road network, bank and granary, regimented columns, restrained gold light, dark basalt prisons and tax counters.
mustPreserve: Kaiser at center but not oversized

assets.title: The Ides of Rumie
assets.visualSubject: During a public festival inside the Senate Hall, Brutus and the conspirators close around Kaiser in a tragic circular composition while stunned citizens and senators register betrayal; violence is imminent or restrained, not gore-driven.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 requires Kaisar's assassination and preserves the tragedy of generosity, obligation, fear, and concentrated power.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Senate hall, festival greenery and red cloth, marble floor, civic robes, concealed bronze blades, cold daylight from high clerestory.

assets.title: War of the Successors
assets.visualSubject: In the damaged outskirts of Rumie, Bobei's grieving loyalist army and Brutus's republican survivors converge among broken standards, abandoned debt tablets, refugee carts, and contested roads.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 successor conflict after assassination; current chapter implementation.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Ruined civic road, damaged aqueduct, rival legion standards, funeral cloth, field fortifications, muted bronze, ash and winter red.
mustPreserve: Bobei vengeance and Brutus restoration visibly distinct
Kaiser's absence felt through broken standard

assets.title: The First Emperor
assets.visualSubject: Rumie's new imperial settlement is staged as a Senate restoration ceremony: an intentionally non-identifying serpent ruler stands in restrained profile behind republican robes and ritual screens while the bank, legions, and three-rune program remain visibly centralized and Bobei's defeated standard is lowered.
assets.factionAuthority: C-09 controls the visual trajectory: Meerus ultimately establishes imperial order. The repository's Augustus naming is not promoted through the image.
assets.culturalArchitecturalMaterialLanguage: Restored Senate basilica, republican ceremonial robes, imperial guard geometry, bank counters, three restrained relic forms, bronze and bone with quiet dawn light.
mustAvoid: clear face that settles the unresolved identity mismatch
